blocks.text: INN NEWS - Elections 2024 lately are trending topics in various communities. Of those who work in office, day-to-day labor; housewives, activists; school children, students, to professors and experts in all sorts of kinds of scientists.

This election is also complete with political drama behind it. Starting from the verdict of Capres-Cawapres age limit, the rise of issue 3 presidential periods, to the alleged nepotism by the state leaders.
These issues that threaten Indonesian democracy as if they were clearly shown to the public without any shame.
OLIGARKI REFECTED WITH THE STATIONS FOR THE WARRANTY OF SOUTH, BUT IT JUST NEEDED A PEOPLE TO BE APPRECIATED. THE STATIONS, WHO LIVED TO BE DEVICE, WHO GIVEN TRICITY KILLED.
This unrest goes to academics on various colleges in Indonesia. Two weeks by election, a wave of protests from the union of the major teachers and professors across the campus appeared.
Starting from the UGM fighting campus, these protests are rolling into UII, UI, Unpad, Unhas, UMY, and other colleges.

As a general citizen, it is not to underestimate the attitude of these academics. The highest education agency, which is full of ideas about the political and government of this nation, is for democracy to say one vote: it's restless by today's democratic conditions.

In a petition of protests, the University of Indonesia (UI) calls for the rise of drums restoring torn country democracy. Whereas Hasanuddin University (Unhas) reminds President Jokowi and all the state officials, law enforcement, and political actors who are in the cabinet to stay in the democratic corridor.
From the keywords received from every college petition, all agreed that Indonesian democracy under Jokowi government was not well.
How do we respond?

Of course, this protest should not be taken lightly, let alone been labeled with a face-to-face label of love, riding, and affiliated with certain camps. The academics of both citizens who have a right to speak up.

Even their opinion needs to be heard as an expression that gives recommendations to the president. Their opinions should be heard as scientific criticism and the corrective material of Jokowi's government.
As a great teacher and educator, the attitude of academics on this campus certainly gives a correct example to imitate.
A mature democracy, declaring disapproval of attitude with firm and ethical ways. It's as if it's deliberately giving contrast to the current government that's non-ethical in politics.

Remember a motto from the father of Indonesia, Ki-Kiat-Bakhtawar, Dewaksa (Akalah), Wasih (tawadah al-Mahfuz), It seems like this is what the teachers and the teachers are trying to get into, and this petition is all about.
It inspires ideas and ideas, as well as the urge of vast societies to respond to their anxiety.
Will students just shut up?

As a fellow educated man, the role of a student is responding to this petition of protest. It's certainly awaited. Indonesian students today are Generation Z, who are forced to be the voice-decisive voice of the 2024 election. The pallons are fighting over the young voices in a variety of ways.
The most exciting way to pick their voice is with a gimmick. The thing is, will students forever be able to believe in gimmick?

Although Generation Z is often labeled a generation that likes something entertainment, I still believe in this generation as an intelligent generation of resolving information. Not just a gimmick trust, but a generation that precedes conscience and logic, including winning the choice at the 2024 election.

The petition of the great teacher and professor is like confirming and validation for the problems that are happening, but the voice of the young people remains key. The proportion of the votes dominated by young generations can change the map of Indonesian democracy.

There are still nine days before the elections, and it's time for the young generation to step aside from a little bit of social media distortion filled with pieces of video that have been polished in such a way by political buzzer.
Use time to restudy the track record, the affiliated party, the Paslon priority issue, the Pallon mission vision, and everything you don't know about elections 2024.
Make sure your conscience is right, so that we are built to choose leaders who also uphold the truth and use the correct means of power.
Students and young generation, let's stop being apathetic and not care. When the reality is shown before your eyes, then use your common sense to digest it all.
When you have people standing up for you, consider it a similar move. Be critical, ethical in opinion, and keep democracy in control of this nation!
